Context: 9. Gratuity

- Rule 22 of Payment of Gratuity under NPS.  
5. Residuary Gratuity.When an employee dies within five years after retirement, and the total amount actually received by him on account of pension (or service gratuity), dearness relief on pension, retirement gratuity, commutation amount, is less than 12 times the 'emoluments' drawn at the time of retirement, the deficiency is granted to his nominee I family. This is 'Residuary Gratuity'. - Rule 45 (3).
